supplementaryReferences.note: Cut shoots are chopped, heat-oxidised, dried and sieved; green tea is dried without oxidation. Fresh shoot kg is not dried tea kg. C. genistoides is a specific commercial species, not every honeybush species.

productionGuidance.products: leafy shoots for dried honeybush tea
care: Use species-suitable, well-drained acidic fynbos conditions and confirm local frost exposure.
Record fresh cuttings and dried tea output separately; no automatic drying conversion or safe storage duration is assigned.
purchase: Ask a specialist local nursery for identified C. genistoides and a locally proven selection; different ecotypes do not perform equally.
